mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the broader economic regime.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of observations where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 115), manufacturing output expansion signals strong corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of observations where INDPRO exceeds 115, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of the broader economic regime.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of observations where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer demand (RSAFS > 350,000 and HOUST > 1000), retail sales and housing activity support elevated corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 350,000 and HOUST > 1000)
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of observations where both RSAFS exceeds 350,000 and HOUST exceeds 1000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1020 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1020, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
